lines.zh: 我的脚步，和你的重叠了。
lines.en: My steps fall exactly on yours.

lines.zh: 我的脚不落地，只有声音
lines.en: My feet don't land; only the sound does.
You speed up, so do I.
I come through the other side of the wall.
My shadow is a little longer than yours.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有我，仅此而已
lines.en: I'm at the corridor's end. That's all.
Each step I take dims a lamp.
I round the chair without a sound.
I hug the wall; my shadow arrives first.
You needn't turn around. I know.
When I stop, so do you.

lines.zh: 我在等你说出那个名字
lines.en: I wait for you to say that name.
I stand still with my head tilted.
I listen to your breathing.
I have no need to blink.

lines.zh: 找到你了，别把眼睛闭上。
lines.en: Found you — don't close your eyes.

lines.zh: 我在数你还有多少口气
lines.en: I count how many breaths you have left.
My fingers close very slowly.
Every door in this room is shut.

lines.zh: 我要你听见自己的心跳
lines.en: I want you to hear your own heart.
I'm waiting for you to close your eyes.

lines.zh: 你睁开的时候，我会更近
lines.en: When you open them, I'll be closer.
I've finally found you.
I lift my head; my eyes meet yours.

lines.zh: 我偏着头，看你能撑多久。
lines.en: I tilt my head, watching how long you last.
I remember the rhythm of your walk.
Your face is paler than last time.

lines.zh: 我一直在这，只是你没看
lines.en: I've always been here. You just didn't look.
My steps stop outside your door.
You were given the warning.
Close your eyes, or look at me.
I'm in no hurry. You can't escape.
There's a wall right behind you.
This time I'm not hiding.
At last, face to face.
You hit me, and I smiled.
My shape dispersed a little.
No blood from the wound. Only black.
I give half a step, still watching.
That made the room colder still.

lines.zh: 你听见我骨头的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear my bones?
No pain. I'm provoked.
My head tilts further.
You saw me. Now don't run.
Then we'll be closer still.
You raise a torch, and I don't flinch.
You reach out, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只要你在
lines.en: I don't eat. I only want you here.
What do you think food buys?
Set it down and your hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的手，不是它
lines.en: I'm watching your hand, not that.
That smell draws me nearer.
The tenser you get, the clearer the scent.
You retreat; I give up almost nothing.
Hold it higher. I can reach.
You run into me and it's cold as ice.
I have no weight. You can't grip me.

lines.zh: 你从我的身体里穿过去
lines.en: You pass right through me.
That touch will leave your hand numb.
I give half a step, then crowd in again.
Your breath stops for half a second.
Don't touch me. It brings me nearer.
I scatter and gather again.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子交叠了一下
lines.en: Our shadows overlap once on the wall.
Now you know where I am.
Such things shouldn't come in pairs.
Will you stay? Forever.

lines.zh: 我可以一直站在你身边
lines.en: I can stand beside you forever.
You needn't sleep. Neither do I.
This room holds two shadows.
I'll remember the sound of your breathing.
When you stop being afraid, come closer.

lines.zh: 我们从今晚开始，一直数下去
lines.en: From tonight we count on, and on.

lines.zh: 你别关灯，关了就看不见我
lines.en: Don't turn off the light. You'd lose sight of me.
But I'd know where you are.
I can't pick anything up.
My hands only pass through them.
Yours, and I don't need it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我也看不见
lines.en: I don't see things on the floor either.
All I collect is your attention.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的时候，我就在上面
lines.en: When you bend down, I'm right above.
Don't look down. Look up.
Keep it. It's no use to me.

lines.zh: 你手上空出来的位置，很好
lines.en: The empty space in your hand is good.
Pick it up and go. I'll follow.
You said that word.
I've stepped out of the dark.
You closed your eyes half a beat late.
Now you belong to this night.
I've found where you are.
The door isn't where it was.
Your footsteps are all out of order.
I'm right behind you. Very near.
Don't shout. It's still me.
I can see your hands shaking.
Breathe. Slower. That's it.
I come one step at a time. No leaping.
The air behind you has grown heavy.
This time I won't walk away.
Until you close your eyes.
Found you. It's that simple.

lines.zh: 找到你了，正在数你的步。
lines.en: Found you — counting your steps.
Three turns and I'm still here.
I move to the corridor's other side.

lines.zh: 你听不见我的声音，对吧
lines.en: You can't hear me, can you?

lines.zh: 你的影子边上多了一道
lines.en: There's a second shadow by yours.
I wait for you to lower your hand.
You go left; I'm on the left.
You go right; I'm there too.
This house has very few exits.
I remember every one of them.
You've stopped to catch your breath. Good.
I'm one blink away.
Don't try to count my steps.
You'll get it wrong. Stop counting.

lines.zh: 我一直在原地等你回头
lines.en: I've been standing here, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我会微笑
lines.en: When you turn, I'll be smiling.
Now. Stand still.
I've already reached my hand out.
This time I won't miss.
That second shadow behind you is me.
My hand comes to rest on your shoulder.
You turn and I'm already there.
It doesn't hurt. It's only cold.
I take hold of your breathing.
Your sight is going dark at the edges.
I whisper at your ear: don't open them.
Do you hear it? Right behind you.
This grab comes from behind.
Your legs went weak half a beat.
I hold you in place.
Struggling won't help. I'd know.
You closed your eyes too late.
I won't leave a single mark.
Only you will remember any of it.
Don't open your eyes. Not yet.
Just a moment more. That's all.
Your hands have fallen.
I'm close. Very close.
This night, you're mine.
And now everything is over.

lines.zh: 我出现在你说完那句话之后
lines.en: I appear after you finish that sentence.
The lights went out once, and there I was.

lines.zh: 这里的空气先冷了下来
lines.en: The air here chilled first.
Did you hear the warning tone?
I came in through the door's gap.

lines.zh: 我不该在这里，但我来了
lines.en: I shouldn't be here. But here I am.

lines.zh: 地板没有响，我已经在屋里
lines.en: The floor didn't creak, yet I'm inside.
You turn and see me exactly.
Now, close your eyes.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的门框里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the doorway behind you.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有了第二个呼吸
lines.en: This room has a second breath now.
I came. I found you.
You should have held your breath.
The night is long. We'll take our time.
Fire scatters me into smoke.
I fall, and never land.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的形状浮起来
lines.en: Water fills in and my shape floats.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的形推开又合上
lines.en: The blast pushes my shape apart and back.
The arrow passes through and pins the wall.
That light pushes me back a few steps.
The emptier I get, the closer I want to be.

lines.zh: 雷光照出我的形状，很完整
lines.en: Lightning lights up my shape, complete.
There's no dark left to hide in.
